**Stellar Data:** A system of 2 stars, aged 10 gigayears. Laurelle-A is class M5-V, mass 0.21, luminosity 0.008. Laurelle-B is class M6-V, mass 0.16, luminosity 0.0045, and it circles Laurelle-A every 1.0 years at between 87 million km and 131 million km. Twins of Abernoth's stars in class, mass and light, but bound far closer, circling each other once a year, and no worlds formed around them. Discovered 1 October 307 by SV-05 Open Question under SLT Genevieve Hautpierre.
